title: Claude compact hook: a compaction that ends without compact_boundary can leave compaction_refresh_requested set and swallow the next boundary's refresh
outcome: Review Low from the w-30eca590e985 review pair (Claude claude-fable-5-1 delegation-69c3545a, freeze cd5dedb8). In src/claude_frame_application.rs, ClaudeReaderFrames.compaction_refresh_requested is reset only by a status=compacting frame and consumed only by compact_boundary. Suppose a callback is answered but its compaction ends without a boundary (an aborted compaction), on a runtime that emits no status=compacting before the next compaction. Then the next boundary's refresh request is swallowed, and the following prompt carries no fresh context. Live Claude Code 2.1.288 sends status=compacting before every capture's callback, so the window needs both an aborted compaction and no status frame. Possible fixes: clear the flag at the end of a compaction without a boundary (a status frame with compact_result other than success), or at the runtime's next init, with a test.
acceptance: Claude compact hook: a compaction that ends without compact_boundary can leave compaction_refresh_requested set and swallow the next boundary's refresh is done
